registered: 2026-10-14, before any feature or score exists
decided_by: user (budget, merge, hit rule, VF-10 reference); others from model_map v0.6 and design/11

evaluation_slices.inferential: VF-10 test sessions (5 with anomalies, 5 all-normal)
evaluation_slices.exploratory: VMX30Ui label-1 events with clip_ratio <= 0.01 (3 sessions; below the 4-session rule)

event_auc_pooling: mean of top-3 window scores (all windows if fewer than 3)

false_alarm_budget.denominator: label-0 cutting time of the validation sessions
false_alarm_budget.alarm_merge: above-threshold windows whose starts are <= 5 s apart form one alarm
false_alarm_budget.threshold_fit: lab: inner leave-one-session-out on the fold's training sessions; VF-10: leave-one-reference-out

hit_rule: an anomalous event counts as detected if any window inside it exceeds the threshold
report_separately: normal events inside sessions that also contain anomalies (shortcut test)

uncertainty.p_values_only_if: >= 4 sessions with anomalies in the slice

training_data: label-0 cutting events of the fold's training/reference sessions only; same machine only
alignment_note: 4 sessions with conf < 0.3 do not affect C1 (static context from label.csv); excluded only from research-version observer 2 and C2
